title: PyLoan replaces an explicit 100 payment with a 919.10 final payment
summary: PyLoan 0.7.2 overrides a specified annuity payment at maturity. A synthetic schedule pays 919.10 instead of 100; a targeted candidate removes 408 payment-cap violations in 864 scenarios. Separate rounding differences and unchanged upstream test failures are retained.
author: Xamit Kadirbekov
limitations: Synthetic library schedules; no bank deployment or customer harm claim. 24 exact-oracle rounding differences remain; upstream unittest suite retains three baseline failure reports. Candidate only, not accepted upstream.
